title: Present Perfect (yet, just, already) and Past Simple
en:
have / has + past participle connects the past with now: I've finished the report (it's ready now).

just — a very short time ago; already — earlier than expected; yet — in questions and negatives, at the end: I've just sent it. She's already left. Have you finished yet? I haven't called him yet.

Experience: ever / never: Have you ever been to London? I've never seen it.

Present Perfect or Past Simple? If you say or ask when (yesterday, last week, in 2020, ago), use the Past Simple: I've been to Astana. I went there last year.
ru: have/has + 3-я форма — результат к настоящему, опыт (ever/never), just — только что, already — уже, yet — ещё/уже (в вопросах и отрицаниях, в конце). Если указано или спрашивается КОГДА (yesterday, ago, last week) — Past Simple.

boss.situation: Write a status update for your manager: what you have already done, what you have just finished and what you haven't done yet. Add one sentence in the Past Simple with a time.
samples: I've already tested five of the eight controls.
I've just finished the interview with the warehouse manager.
I haven't received the documents from procurement yet.
Have you seen my email about the deadline?
I sent the draft report to you yesterday.

qs.q: I ___ my keys. I can't find them.
She ___ to Dubai last year.
Have you finished the report ___?
I've ___ sent the email — two minutes ago.
qs.exp: A very short time ago → just.

qs.q: ___ you ever worked abroad?
He hasn't called me ___.
When ___ you start this job?
The past participle of “write” is ___.
We've ___ finished — earlier than we expected!
I ___ never ___ a car accident.
“I have seen him yesterday” is correct.
“She has gone to Astana” means she is in Astana or on the way now.
qs.exp: has gone = went and is still there; has been = went and came back.

qs.q: I ___ (already / send) the invoices.
qs.exp: already between have and the participle.

qs.q: Have you ever ___ (be) to London?
She ___ (not / finish) the presentation yet.
We ___ (meet) the new director last Monday.
I've ___ (just / have) lunch, so I'm not hungry.
How many reports ___ you written this month?
Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: have you checked the figures yet
qs.exp: yet at the end of the question.

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: i have just spoken to the auditor
qs.exp: just between have and the participle.

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: she has never been late for work
qs.exp: never between has and the participle.

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: we have already approved the budget

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: when did you finish the project

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: they have not answered my email yet

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “I have finished it last week.”
Correct the mistake: “Did you ever visit Paris?”
a: Have you ever been to Paris?

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “She has went home.”
Correct the mistake: “I haven't yet finished.”
Correct the mistake: “When have you arrived?”
Correct the mistake: “He already has signed the contract.”
a: He has already signed the contract.
qs.exp: already goes between has and the participle.

qs.q: Я уже отправил отчёт.
a: I have already sent the report.
I have already sent a report.

qs.q: Ты когда-нибудь работал за границей?
Я только что поговорил с аудитором.
a: I've just talked to the auditor.
I have just talked to the auditor.
I've just spoken to the auditor.
I have just spoken to the auditor.
I have just spoken with the auditor.
I have just talked with the auditor.

qs.q: Она ещё не ответила.
Я никогда не был в Лондоне.
a: I have never been to London.

qs.q: Мы встретились в прошлом году.
Ты уже проверил цифры?
a: Have you checked the figures yet?
Have you already checked the figures?
Have you checked the numbers yet?
Have you already checked the numbers?

qs.q: Когда ты начал эту работу?
a: When did you start this job?
When did you begin this job?
When did you start this work?

qs.q: Я потерял ключи и не могу войти.
a: I've lost my keys and I can't get in.
I have lost my keys and I cannot get in.
I have lost my keys and I can't get in.
I've lost my keys and can't get in.
I have lost my keys and cannot get in.

qs.q: Он уехал в Астану (и сейчас там).
